nodes.text: @fperrywilson I was wondering about the same last week, even though hMPV activity peaks in April and May. So far, the regional (except maybe FL) and national data are comparable to last season. (https://t.co/XryB1qp3Uo) https://t.co/RJgMfhPYD1

nodes.text: @Ivan_Boyadzhiev Good to know. So maybe just expected seasonal variation.  This is why we don't "overcall" a cluster... randomness is chunky.
